_comment: v15 rev5 defaults (DSA_V15_L2X=1, DQ_MERGE=1, REGSWAP=0, ALLTMA=0). Keys override stage0_analyzer.py module constants. Update TARGET_REVISION/TARGET_SOURCE_SHA256 per commit under test. G1: REGSWAP=0 keeps the v12 register layout but the v15 dispatch has two separate DEALLOC-48 branch sites (gather; W16-19). G2: W17 must be zero-delta (ALLTMA=0 restores v12 fill code at the v12 budget); W16 zero-delta (DQ_MERGE only removes a block boundary); W18 gets +4 LDL allowance -- its role was rewritten under L2X, so zero-delta vs the v12 DSM program is the wrong yardstick (rev4 measured 9 vs 9 at 64 regs; the bound covers allocator drift at 48).
